limitations: Finite-perturbation response of the recorded algorithm, including noise, sampling, regularisation and the actual stopping state.
These matrices are not a converged Jacobian, measured patient composition or scanner calibration.
Shared Poisson components couple the three scenarios within each replicate. The two replicate namespaces are independent.
The mean and range describe these two replicates only, without a population interval or a required-win threshold.
A response smaller than paired noise variation is unresolved, not evidence of zero cross-talk.
Display windows and centre-plane interpolation do not change the complete-array metrics or retained response fields.
